messages:
mira: Heads up — planning a devcontainer base-image rebuild next week. Need to finalize KMS keywrap for image signing and RBAC for the signer SA. Who's the owner for the signer permission changes?

sam: I can own the IAM changes. plan is to create a dedicated signer SA with only `cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToSign` and limited GCS push. no broad roles. :lock:

olivia: For audit logging we need: key use logs -> export to logs buckets, image-sign events -> push to audit topic. Can we add a log-based metric for any unsigned-image-deploy attempts?

mira: yes — add the metric. also we need an emergency rollback path if the buildbot starts signing broken images.

security-bot: CI_ALERT: container-scan found 1 HIGH vuln in staging base (alpine:3.15). CVE-2024-9999. ticket: https://tracker/reports/INC-3421 :warning:

kenji: triage note — that CVE is patched by moving to alpine:3.18 or applying patch layer. we should bake patch into base before signing.

sam: suggested IAM commands (devops):
```
# grant signer SA only crypto sign on key
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/images --key my-signing-key \
  --member=serviceAccount:signer-sa@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier
```

sam: also will restrict signer SA to only write to `redwood-image-signatures-prod` GCS prefix. no read to infra secrets.

olivia: audit export: logs to `projects/redwood/logs/image_signer` and sink to bigquery for queries. retention 90d. ops wants 365d for enterprise customers — flagging for product.

mira: RBAC checklist: owner (sam), approver (kenji), reviewer (olivia). can we get approvals by EOD tomorrow?

ops-dave: timeline OK. we'll put a canary: sign 2 canary images, deploy to staging only, run smoke + vuln scan, then promote. Rollback plan: disable signer SA in IAM (fast) + revoke key version if needed.

kenji: one more — key rotation cadence. recommended 90d with automated new key version creation. we must make sure old versions remain valid for verifying previously signed manifests.

mira: thanks. ACTIONS: @sam create IAM PR, @olivia create audit sink & metric, @kenji add rotation doc, @ops-dave schedule canary window. I'll open the rebuild ticket and attach these items.

sam: PR will reference the IAM least-priv policy and add a staging-only binding to kick off canary.

security-bot: NOTE: remember to sign SBOM artifacts too (cosign attest) — audit shows unsigned SBOMs are a blindspot.

mira: good catch. include SBOM signing in the bake step.

ops-dave: scheduling canary for Tue 09:00 PST. if no issues by Tue 13:00 we'll promote to prod. I'll post the runbook in the ticket.

mira: perfect. thanks everyone — i'll follow up with the ticket link and add the sign-off checklist. :thumbsup:
